adjudication.rationale: The diff makes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` an array and, in `handleNewBooking.ts`, appends additional collective hosts’ destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). However, when persisting the booking, it still writes only a single 1:1 Prisma relation by connecting only the first element (`connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`). Downstream code that rebuilds `evt` from the stored booking (e.g. payment webhooks, booking reminders, cancel/reschedule flows shown in the diff) only has access to `booking.destinationCalendar` (single) and wraps it into a one-element array, so any additional host calendars added in-memory cannot be recovered after reload. This is a correctness/data-consistency issue introduced/exposed by the change to an array shape without a backing multi-row persistence.
